players.product: Recursion OS, biological foundation models, and Lab-in-the-Loop drug engine

quarterly_data.signal: Supplier Tempus AI (data license to Recursion): Recursion's 8-K (Item 1.01): on September 15, 2026 Recursion amended its November 3, 2023 Master Agreement with Tempus, which had a five-year term terminable for convenience after three years and Annual License Fees of $22,000,000 (first anniversary), $32,000,000 (second anniversary) and $42,000,000 (each of the third and fourth anniversaries), payable 100% in Recursion shares at its election. The amendment extends the term from five to six years, eliminates Recursion's right to terminate for convenience, revises the Annual License Fees payable by Recursion to $14,000,000 on each of the third, fourth and fifth anniversaries (at least $4,000,000 in cash, the remainder in shares, cash or both at Recursion's election), and decreases the aggregate total of unique de-identified data records Recursion may access.
quarterly_data.figure: term extended from five to six years; fewer unique de-identified data records accessible; $14,000,000 Annual License Fee on each of the third, fourth and fifth anniversaries (at least $4,000,000 in cash)

connects_to.relationship: licenses its RNA sequencing foundation model TxFM to Tempus (non-exclusive, worldwide)

contracts.signal: Recursion's 8-K (Item 1.01): on September 15, 2026 Recursion entered into an RNA Foundation Model License Agreement granting Tempus a non-exclusive, non-sublicensable, non-transferable, worldwide license to its TxFM Model solely for use in oncology (diagnostic and clinical applications and Tempus's internal R&D), for a term of two years. Tempus will pay a non-refundable license fee of $12,000,000 in two installments of $6,000,000 (on execution and on the first anniversary) and will give Recursion access to a certain number of de-identified pathology records with linked clinical data during the term.
contracts.units: non-exclusive worldwide TxFM license (oncology field), two-year term
contracts.value: $12,000,000 license fee in two installments of $6,000,000
